description: Block rendering a table that aggregates page properties across pages matching configured labels and columns (via a provider), with clickable page-title links and editable configuration, plus no-provider, loading, and empty states.

parameters.name: Block
parameters.description: Owning page block for focus context.

parameters.name: OnContentChanged
parameters.description: Raised when edited report configuration should be persisted.

parameters.name: OnFocused
parameters.description: Raised when the block receives focus.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Whether report configuration controls are hidden.
